messages:
Nora: Pinging design for a quick microcopy review. Empty state for the inference request queue looks a bit dry. Current copy: 'No requests yet'. Screenshot in the thread.
Jin: Agreed — 'No requests yet' doesn't guide next steps. We should push a clear primary CTA. Options: 'Create request', 'Send a test request', 'Try a sample prompt'.
Carlos: For dev-first audience, I like 'Send a test request' since it maps to the action in the API. Also consider a tiny code sample link.
Priya: Tone question: friendly vs terse. This is in the Console where users are in a flow; I'd avoid overly casual copy. Maybe: 'You haven't sent any inference requests yet.' Then subcopy: 'Try a sample prompt or send your first request to see results.'
Nora: Good. What about the primary CTA label? 'Send test request' vs 'Try sample prompt' vs 'Send first request'. Keep it verb-first.
Jin: 'Try a sample prompt' is more discoverable for new users. For experienced users, an inline 'Send via API' link below could be useful.
Carlos: Accessibility: CTA should be a <button> with aria-describedby pointing to the helper text. Provide a hidden hint for screen readers: 'Opens a modal with sample prompts and a run button.'
Priya: Localization note: avoid words like 'sample' in some locales — we may want 'example' as fallback. Also keep CTA <= 25 chars to avoid truncation in German.
Nora: Draft final candidates:
A) Title: 'No inference requests yet' Body: 'Try a sample prompt or send your first request to get started.' Primary CTA: 'Try a sample prompt' Secondary: 'Send via API'
B) Title: 'No requests found' Body: 'Send a test request from the Console or run the example curl below.' Primary CTA: 'Send a test request' Secondary: 'View example'
C) Title: 'Ready to make your first request?' Body: 'Use a sample prompt or paste your request payload.' Primary CTA: 'Get started' Secondary: 'Docs'
Jin: I prefer A for onboarding clarity.
Carlos: I suggest tweak to body in A: remove 'get started' redundancy. 'Try a sample prompt or send your first request.'
Priya: And change 'Send via API' to 'Send via API (curl)' maybe, but keep short. Or put 'Send via API' as a plain link under helper text.
Nora: Accessibility checklist:
- Title should use heading semantics (h2)
- Provide aria-live polite when queue updates from remote
- Buttons focusable and announce that a modal will open
- Color contrast AA for CTA and secondary link
Nora: Action items:
- @Priya: finalize copy and i18n-safe variants (owner).
- @Jin: add aria-describedby and live-region notes to the component PR.
- @Carlos: add the small code-sample option to the modal and minimal curl example.
- @design-bot: create a tracking task for the change.
design-bot: Task created: UI-QUEUE-27 "Inference queue empty state copy + a11y" Assigned: Priya, Jin, Carlos Due: 2024-07-22
Priya: I'll post the final approved variant in this thread once legal and localization review it.
Nora: Thanks team — aiming to ship with next console patch. :sparkles:
